name: Roberto Gonzalez Barrera
current_role: Deceased (died 25 Aug 2012, Houston, Texas); was chairman of Gruma and lifetime honorary chairman of Grupo Financiero Banorte
notes: Died 25 August 2012 aged 81. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roberto_Gonz%C3%A1lez_Barrera ; https://expansion.mx/negocios/2012/08/25/fallece-roberto-gonzalez-barrera . Son Juan Antonio Gonzalez Moreno now leads Gruma.

name: Mario Brescia Cafferata
current_role: Deceased (died 16 May 2013, Lima); was co-chairman of Grupo Breca and chairman of BBVA Continental
notes: Died May 2013. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mario_Brescia_Cafferata ; https://www.mch.cl/fallece-empresario-peruano-mario-brescia-presidente-del-holding-breca-dueno-de-cemento-melon-y-pinturas-tricolor/ . Grupo Breca is now run by the next generation of the Brescia family.

name: Paolo Zegna
current_role: Non-executive director, Ermenegildo Zegna N.V.; vice-chairman of family holding Monterubello; chairman of Lanificio Ermenegildo Zegna e Figli
profile: Third-generation member of the Zegna family (born Turin 1956, economics degree from Geneva). He was co-CEO of the group in 1998-2006 and chairman from 2006 until the 2021 NYSE listing, and now sits on the board as a non-executive director. His cousin Gildo is executive chairman. He also chairs the historic Trivero wool mill.
interesting_fact: He served as president of Sistema Moda Italia, Italy's textile and apparel industry association. He has also been vice-president of the Altagamma Foundation and sits on the council of Euratex, the European textile association.
deep_cut_fact: He chairs Achill Land Pty Ltd, the company behind Zegna's 60%-owned Achill merino sheep farm east of Armidale, New South Wales. Zegna bought into the farm in 2014 to secure its own fine-wool supply. Sixth-generation grower Charlie Coventry kept the other 40%.
notes: The source of wealth matches (Zegna). No personal social accounts found. The best route is the group's corporate press office, which is run by Paola Durante, Chief of External Relations.
